metadata.scenario: A caller requests a quote for catering services for an upcoming event. Category: New Inquiry. Outcome: quote_provided. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is George Williams. I hope you’re doing well. Hi George! I'm doing well, thank you. How about you? I’m good, thanks! I wanted to check on a quote for catering services for an upcoming event. Oh, I’m sorry, George. We actually don’t provide catering services. We focus on home healthcare. Oh, I see. I must have gotten that mixed up. No problem at all! Is there something else I can assist you with? Well, since I’m on the line, I’d love to know if there are any updates on my cardiac care monitoring. Certainly! Your last visit was about a week ago, right? Yes, that's correct. I just want to ensure everything is okay. All your vitals were stable during the last assessment, but let me check with your nurse for more detailed updates. That would be great, thanks! Would you like me to schedule another visit for you? Yes, that sounds good. When would be the earliest? We have openings next Tuesday and Thursday. Which works better for you? Let’s go with Tuesday. Perfect! I’ll schedule that visit for you. Thank you! Also, I might need some personal care assistance in the future. We can definitely help with that! We offer personal care assistance starting at $28 per hour. That sounds reasonable. Can you send me more information on that? Sure! I’ll have our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen, reach out to you with the details. That would be very helpful. Thank you! No problem, George. Just to confirm, you wanted to schedule the visit for Tuesday at your usual time? Yes, please! Great! I’ll handle that now. Is there anything else I can assist you with? Nope, that’s all for now. Thanks for your help! You’re welcome! Have a great day, George! You too, Margaret. Bye! Bye!
